login.title: Login
tips: Sign in with the email and password provided by your organization.
Use "Forgot password?" if you can't sign in.
You can also sign in with Google or Microsoft if your organization has enabled it.

register.title: Create an account
tips: Enter your information to create your learner account.
Your account is created with "pending" status: you won't be able to sign in until a manager (your direct supervisor) activates it.
A manager (supervisor/manager/director, or an admin if none is set) is automatically notified of your request.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
tips: Enter your email to receive a reset link.
Check your spam folder if you don't receive anything after a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
tips: Choose a new, sufficiently strong password.
The reset link is only valid for a limited time.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
tips: See your progress, learning time, and badges at a glance.
The catalog at the bottom of the page lists your in-progress, mandatory, and recommended courses.
Click "Continue" to resume a course where you left off.

courses.title: Courses
tips: Browse all courses available for your organization.
Use search and filters to find a course by category or level.
Click a course to see its detailed content and enroll.

courseDetail.title: Course detail
tips: Click "Enroll" to join the course before starting a lesson.
Review the syllabus, objectives, and reviews before starting.
Track your progress module by module in the "Progress" tab.
A certificate of completion is issued at the end if the course offers one.

lessons.title: Lesson catalog
tips: Find all your lessons in a single catalog, across every course.
Filter by tab: "In progress", "Mandatory", or "All".
Search a lesson by title, or filter by course if you're taking several courses.

lesson.title: Lesson
tips: The lesson content (video, document, or link) is displayed on this page.
Mark the lesson as complete to advance your tracking.
If the lesson includes a quiz, it's accessible from this page.

lessonQuizzes.title: Lesson quizzes
tips: Find all quizzes associated with this lesson here.
The allowed number of attempts and time limit are shown on each quiz.

quizCreate.title: Create a quiz
tips: Set the title, passing score, and quiz settings (attempts, duration, random draw).
You'll be able to add questions once the quiz is created.

quizTake.title: Take a quiz
tips: Answer the questions before the time limit expires, if one is set.
Your score and, depending on the configuration, the correct answers are shown after submission.
The number of remaining attempts is shown at the top of the page.

quizManageQuestions.title: Manage quiz questions
tips: Add, edit, or delete the quiz's questions from this page.
Several question types are available: MCQ, True/False, short answer, essay.

badges.title: Badges
tips: View the badges you've unlocked as you progress through your courses.
Each badge specifies its earning criteria.

certificates.title: Certificates
tips: Find all your earned certificates of completion here.
Download them as PDFs to share or archive them.
A certificate may have an expiration date: you'll be notified before it expires, prompting you to retake the course.

notifications.title: Notifications
tips: Find reminders, messages, and news relevant to you here.
Click a notification to go directly to the related item.

search.title: Search
tips: Search for courses, lessons, articles, quizzes, or live sessions.
Use the tabs to filter results by type.
The quick search in the header (magnifying glass) gives direct access without leaving your current page.

chat.title: Chat
tips: Chat in real time with your instructors and colleagues.
Select a conversation from the list to open it.

chatConversation.title: Conversation
tips: Send messages and attachments in this conversation.
Messages are synced in real time across all participants.

live.title: Live sessions
tips: View upcoming, live, and past recorded sessions.
Click a session to see its details: instructor, schedule, participants, and video conferencing link (if provided).
From the detail view, click "Enroll" for an upcoming session, or "Join" once it's live.

liveDetail.title: Live session detail
tips: Enroll in a scheduled session with "Enroll", or join it with "Join" once it's live.
If no video conferencing link was configured by the organizer, your enrollment/attendance is still recorded, but no link opens automatically.

blog.title: Blog
tips: Discover articles published by your organization.
Leave a comment to engage with other readers.

blogPost.title: Article
tips: Read the full article and leave a comment to engage with other readers.
Replies to comments appear as a threaded discussion.
You can delete your own comments; managers, directors, and admins can also moderate others'.

profile.title: My profile
tips: Edit your personal information and profile picture.
Notification preferences are managed from "Settings", accessible via your avatar menu in the top right.

settings.title: Settings
tips: Choose, per channel (email, SMS, WhatsApp, browser push, mobile push), whether you want to receive notifications relevant to you.
In-app notifications (the bell at the top of the screen) always remain visible, regardless of your choice here — only deliveries to other channels are affected.

aiTutor.title: AI Assistant
tips: Ask the assistant your questions to get help with your courses.
The assistant can recommend content tailored to your progress.

contentUpload.title: Content import
tips: Upload documents, videos, or other educational resources.
The accepted formats and maximum size are shown during import.

myTeam.title: My Team
tips: Track the progress of team members directly reporting to you (you only see hierarchy levels below yours, never your peers or superiors).
As a supervisor, your team is limited to the agents explicitly assigned to you ("Users" page, "Direct supervisor" field) — not the whole department.
The "Overdue mandatory courses" card sums up mandatory assignments past their due date for your team.
Enable "Periodic report" to automatically receive, in-app and/or by email, a summary of your team's progress (daily or weekly frequency, day of your choice).

adminHome.title: Analytics (administration)
tips: Overview of the platform's usage and engagement statistics.
Switch between the user workspace and administration via the button at the top of the sidebar.

adminAnalytics.title: Analytics
tips: Track key metrics: active users, courses taken, completion rate.
Use the period selector to adjust the analysis range.
The "Lesson drop-off" tab shows, for a given course, the percentage of learners who reach each lesson — useful for spotting where they drop off.

adminUsers.title: Users
tips: Create, edit, or deactivate user accounts.
Assign roles (learner, manager, instructor, admin...) and organizational affiliations.
Use search to quickly find a user.

The "Import" button creates multiple accounts at once from a CSV or Excel file (columns: email, displayName, role, and company/division/department codes optionally). For a pre-filled Excel template, use the "Data import" page.
A director/manager only sees and manages users at a hierarchy level below theirs, attached to their division/department — never their peers or superiors.
For an agent, the "Direct supervisor" field assigns them a specific supervisor: that supervisor will only see agents explicitly assigned to them in "My Team", not the whole department.
External and Intern are user types with exactly the same permissions as Agent — they only allow distinguishing external contractors and interns from employees in lists and reports.

Status: "Pending" (self-service registration not yet activated), "Active", "Suspended" (by an admin, or automatically for inactivity), and "Deactivated". Each row's action menu allows activating, suspending, reactivating, or deactivating an account.
The "Automatic suspension for inactivity" card (admin only) sets, per account type, after how many days without login an active account is automatically suspended.

adminCourses.title: Course management
tips: Create new courses with the "New course" button.
Publish or unpublish a course, and edit its status directly in the edit form.
Use "Manage content" to add modules, lessons, and quizzes.
The action menu also lets you duplicate or delete a course.

adminCourseEdit.title: Course content
tips: Organize the course into modules, each containing several lessons.
For a video lesson, choose between an external link (YouTube, Vimeo...) and uploading a local video file (MP4 or WebM, 100 MB maximum).
Add quizzes to a lesson and manage their questions from this page.
The "Settings" tab links back to managing the course's general information.

adminAssignments.title: Assignments
tips: Assign mandatory or recommended courses to users, departments, or divisions.
You can also assign a course to a team ("Teams" page): all its members automatically inherit it, whether they're users, companies, divisions, or departments.
Set a due date for mandatory courses.
Automatic reminders are sent to the learner before and after the due date; if the course remains overdue, their manager is notified.

adminTeams.title: Teams
tips: Create a team with "New team": name, description, then add its members.
A team can group individual users, but also entire companies, divisions, or departments.
Then use the "Assignments" page to assign a course directly to the team: all its members automatically inherit it.

adminBadges.title: Badges (administration)
tips: Each badge has a unique code (e.g. QUIZ_COMPLETED), a name, a type (trophy, quiz completed, perfect score, course started/completed...), and an earning criteria in free-form JSON (e.g. {"type": "quiz_pass"}).
Automatic awarding of certain badges (quiz passed, perfect score, course started/completed) is wired to the badge's code, not to the content of the JSON criteria — that stays informational.

adminCertificates.title: Certificates (administration)
tips: Track certificates issued to learners, their status (valid/revoked), and expiration date.
"Templates" tab: create HTML certificate templates, using the {userName}, {courseName}, {date}, and {certificateNumber} variables. Only one template can be "default" per organization.
Use "Preview" to view a template with sample data before using it.
Revoke a certificate issued by mistake or that has become invalid from the certificate list.

adminLiveSessions.title: Live sessions (administration)
tips: Schedule a new session with the "New session" button — date and time are required.
The "Instructor" field designates who will host the session; that person (or any admin/director/manager) can then start and end it, not necessarily whoever created it.
Once scheduled, start the session with "Start" to make it appear as "Live" to learners, then "End" once finished.
"Cancel" marks a scheduled session as canceled; the trash icon permanently deletes it, along with its participant history.
Edit an existing session (including reassigning the instructor) with the pencil icon.

adminNotifications.title: Notifications (administration)
tips: Send a notification via "Send a notification": choose the channel (in-app, email, SMS, WhatsApp, push) and recipients (all users, a specific user, or an entire role).
The list below shows the history of notifications sent within your organization, with their read/unread status per recipient.

adminEmailQueue.title: Email queue
tips: This queue groups automated notifications (quiz results, live session reminders, certificate expiry, inactivity suspension...) awaiting approval before sending.
Approve or reject each notification individually, or use "Approve all" / "Reject all" to process the whole queue at once.

adminBlog.title: Blog (administration)
tips: Write, publish, or archive posts for your organization.
Manage categories and moderate comments.

adminReports.title: Reports
tips: Generate reports on course progress and compliance.
Export data for your reporting needs.

adminOrganization.title: Organization
tips: Manage your organization's structure: companies, divisions, and departments.
These affiliations are used to target course assignments and also determine what each manager/director can see in "My Team".
To create the entire hierarchy at once from an Excel file, use the "Data import" page.

adminImport.title: Data import
tips: Download each section's Excel template ("Download the template") before filling it in: organization hierarchy, users, courses, lessons, or quizzes.
Fill in the template then import it with "Import"; the row-by-row result (created/skipped/error) is shown right below.
Imports are safe to re-run: an item that already exists (same title, same code) is automatically skipped rather than duplicated.
Importing lessons requires the course to already exist (import it first); importing quizzes requires both the course AND the lesson to already exist.
Visible sections depend on your role: organization hierarchy is admin-only, users are admin/director, courses/lessons/quizzes are admin/director/manager.

adminPlatform.title: Platform
tips: Super admin only: manage all organizations (tenants) on the platform, across all establishments.
"New organization" creates a new tenant, isolated from others (its own users, courses, and data).
"Switch to" changes your active context to act within a given organization, as if you were an admin of that tenant.

adminEmailSettings.title: Email settings
tips: Configure the sending server and transactional email templates.
Test the sending to verify your configuration.

adminLiveKitSettings.title: Video conferencing (LiveKit)
tips: These credentials replace, for this tenant only, the server's global configuration.
Leave disabled to use the global configuration (if defined server-side).
Use "Test the connection" after saving to verify the credentials are valid.
Without configuration (neither tenant nor global), the "Join" button of a session with no external link will show a clear error message instead of the video conference.

adminRecordingSettings.title: Session recording
tips: Configure the S3-compatible external storage (bucket, region, endpoint, access keys) used to keep recordings of live sessions.
Enable "Active for this tenant" so your organization's recordings use this configuration instead of the global one.

adminLogs.title: Audit logs
tips: Review the history of sensitive actions performed on the platform.
Filter by user, action type, or period for your compliance needs.

fallback.title: Help
tips: No specific help is available for this screen.
Use "All topics" below to browse help for other pages.
